CSQTTR integration changes:
- Library entry point with pre-bound loopback listener and owned task lifetime.
- Built-in base rule, optional original ZIP configuration API retained.
- Accepted connection tasks belong to the listener and are aborted on shutdown.
- Bound SOCKS negotiation / initial record / remote connect waits and connection count.
- Failure to restore TTL closes the affected connection.
The separate original CLI and its ZIP/Lua protocol remain documented in README.md.
